is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluates Anopheles gambiae s.l. (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions previous molecular genotyping of the L1014F allele (page 3), but does not report new genotype data for any markers in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not report any new genotype counts or frequencies for the mosquitoes used in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses wild Anopheles gambiae s.l. collected in Covè, Benin (page 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an experimental hut trial.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted at the CREC/LSHTM experimental hut station in Covè, Benin (page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The trial was conducted between July and October 2018 (page 4).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new experimental hut trial.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not report any genotype data, so no supplementary genotype data is needed.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the efficacy of combining a standard pyrethroid LLIN (DuraNet) with IRS insecticides (bendiocarb, chlorfenapyr, pirimiphos-methyl CS) in experimental huts against wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. in Covè, Benin. It reports bioassay mortality results but does not report any new molecular marker genotype data.
